results.test_name: USER-001 – ADMIN USER MANAGEMENT PAGE LOAD
results.objective: Verify that Port Administrator can open User Management and view essential controls.
results.actions: 1. Log in as Port Administrator. 2. Navigate to /admin/users. 3. Verify heading, table, and Create Staff User button.
results.expected_result: User Management page loads successfully and controls are accessible.
results.actual_result: User Management page loaded successfully in 5527 ms. Heading, directory table, and Create Staff User control are visible.
results.remarks: Admin User Management RBAC directory accessible with active session.

results.objective: Verify existing users and their attributes are rendered in the directory table.
results.actions: 1. Inspect directory table headers. 2. Verify presence of required data columns. 3. Verify user profile records in table body.
results.expected_result: Existing users are displayed correctly with operational roles, employee IDs, and status.
results.actual_result: Directory table renders 58 user rows across 8 columns (USER INFO, EMPLOYEE ID, SYSTEM ROLE, DEPARTMENT, CONTACT PHONE, STATUS, CREATED DATE, ACTIONS). Existing users visible.
results.remarks: Verified 58 user records loaded from PostgreSQL.

results.objective: Verify Create User modal opens correctly with all required fields and controls accessible.
results.actions: 1. Click Create Staff User button. 2. Verify modal title, input fields, role selector, auto-generated employee ID, and submit button.
results.expected_result: Create User form loads correctly with input fields, role selector, and action buttons.
results.actual_result: Create User form modal loaded in 1441 ms. All required input fields, auto-allocated Employee ID, and controls are accessible.
results.remarks: Modal includes automatic Employee ID allocation and temporary password generation notice.

results.objective: Verify Port Administrator is NOT available as a selectable role when creating internal staff users.
results.actions: 1. Inspect all option elements of the Internal Staff Role dropdown. 2. Verify absence of Port Administrator / admin role. 3. Verify presence of internal operational roles.
results.expected_result: Port Administrator role is omitted from selectable options; only operational staff roles are available.
results.actual_result: Port Administrator is strictly excluded from role options. Available roles: Port Operations Officer, Customs Officer, Terminal & Logistics Operator, Gate & Truck Operations Officer.
results.remarks: Enforces strict RBAC privilege separation: internal staff creation cannot elevate users to Port Administrator.

results.test_name: USER-005 – CREATE USER EMPTY FORM VALIDATION
results.objective: Verify required fields prevent submission of an empty user creation form.
results.preconditions: Create User modal open with blank required fields.
results.actions: 1. Clear Full Name and Email inputs. 2. Click Create Account. 3. Inspect validation state.
results.expected_result: Submission is blocked and required-field validation feedback is indicated.
results.actual_result: Empty submission blocked successfully in 746 ms. HTML5 valueMissing is True and modal remains open.
results.remarks: Client-side required-field constraints protect backend from blank records.

results.objective: Verify invalid phone numbers are rejected with appropriate validation feedback.
results.preconditions: Create User modal with invalid phone number '12345'.
results.actions: 1. Enter valid name and email. 2. Enter invalid phone '12345'. 3. Submit form. 4. Inspect validation banner.
results.expected_result: Invalid phone number is rejected and validation feedback appears.
results.actual_result: Invalid phone rejected in 8879 ms. Form error displayed: 'Please enter a valid phone number for the selected country.'.
results.remarks: InternationalPhoneInput validates E.164 formats against country calling rules.

results.objective: Verify Port Administrator can create a valid internal staff user account.
results.actions: 1. Enter name 'Selenium Test Operations Officer 20261007153326'. 2. Enter email 'selenium.ops.20261007153326@testportide.com'. 3. Select role 'Port Operations Officer'. 4. Submit form. 5. Verify toast and row visibility.
results.expected_result: User is successfully created and appears in the user directory list.
results.actual_result: Staff user created successfully in 27359 ms. Employee ID: POO-2026-0005. User appears in directory with Port Operations Officer role.
results.remarks: Created User ID: 99, Name: Selenium Test Operations Officer 20261007153326, Email: selenium.ops.20261007153326@testportide.com.

results.objective: Verify the temporary-password workflow: account created with temporary credentials and flagged for mandatory change.
results.actions: 1. Inspect user_must_change_password flag in PostgreSQL. 2. Verify temporary password security policy is active. 3. Configure local test temporary credentials preserving mandatory change flag.
results.expected_result: Temporary password workflow is active with user_must_change_password set to True.
results.actual_result: Temporary password workflow verified in 5721 ms. User profile in PostgreSQL has user_must_change_password=True.
results.remarks: Backend inspection confirmed temporary password generated with mandatory first-login password change flag enabled.

results.test_name: USER-009 – FIRST LOGIN REQUIRES PASSWORD CHANGE
results.objective: Verify newly created staff users are required to change their password on first login.
results.preconditions: Newly created staff user (selenium.ops.20261007153326@testportide.com) with temporary password.
results.actions: 1. Navigate to /login. 2. Authenticate with staff email and temporary password. 3. Observe mandatory password change interception.
results.expected_result: User is intercepted by MandatoryPasswordChangeModal and blocked from accessing the operational dashboard until password change.
results.actual_result: MandatoryPasswordChangeModal intercepted first-login session in 4032 ms. Dashboard access is blocked until password update.
results.remarks: Modal enforced by ProtectedRoute.tsx via mustChangePassword state and session token.

results.objective: Verify first-login password change form successfully updates password and grants dashboard access.
results.actions: 1. Enter compliant new password into New Password and Confirm fields. 2. Submit password change. 3. Verify modal dismissal and dashboard load.
results.expected_result: Password change succeeds, modal closes, and user is admitted to their authorized operational dashboard.
results.actual_result: Password changed successfully in 5376 ms. Modal dismissed and user granted access to Port Operations dashboard (http://localhost:3000/operations/dashboard).
results.remarks: Backend /api/auth/first-login-change-password/ updated password PBKDF2 hash and set user_must_change_password=False.

results.objective: Verify the created staff user can authenticate using their new permanent password.
results.preconditions: Staff user (selenium.ops.20261007153326@testportide.com) with newly updated permanent password.
results.actions: 1. Log out. 2. Navigate to /login. 3. Authenticate with new password. 4. Verify dashboard loads directly.
results.expected_result: User successfully authenticates with new password and sees the role-specific dashboard without modal interception.
results.actual_result: User authenticated successfully in 5902 ms. Navigated directly to operations dashboard without any modal interruption.
results.remarks: Clean role-based landing on Port Operations Dashboard.

results.objective: Verify invalid credentials are rejected after password change.
results.preconditions: Valid user email (selenium.ops.20261007153326@testportide.com) with incorrect test password.
results.actions: 1. Navigate to /login. 2. Enter email and incorrect password. 3. Click Sign In. 4. Verify rejection message.
results.expected_result: Authentication is rejected with appropriate error feedback and user remains on the login page.
results.actual_result: Incorrect password rejected in 3905 ms. Displayed feedback: 'Invalid email or password.'. User remains on /login.
results.remarks: PBKDF2 password verification accurately rejected incorrect credentials.

results.objective: Verify Port Administrator can edit permitted staff user information (Full Name and Phone).
results.preconditions: Staff user row for selenium.ops.20261007153326@testportide.com visible in /admin/users.
results.actions: 1. Click Edit button for selenium.ops.20261007153326@testportide.com. 2. Update Full Name to 'Selenium Test Operations Officer 20261007153326 (Edited)'. 3. Click Save Changes. 4. Verify toast and updated table text.
results.expected_result: Permitted fields update successfully and reflect in the user directory list.
results.actual_result: User updated successfully in 16891 ms. Updated name 'Selenium Test Operations Officer 20261007153326 (Edited)' is rendered in directory table.
results.remarks: Permitted fields update successfully through PUT /api/admin/users/<id>/.

results.test_name: USER-014 – ROLE REMAINS FIXED DURING EDIT
results.objective: Verify user role cannot be changed through the edit interface and remains strictly immutable.
results.actions: 1. Inspect Role field element attributes. 2. Verify disabled/readOnly state. 3. Inspect Employee ID, Email, and Department fields.
results.expected_result: Role field is read-only/disabled with a 'Read Only' indicator; protected fields cannot be altered.
results.actual_result: Role is immutable and strictly read-only ('Port Operations Officer') in 3302 ms. Employee ID, Email, and Department are also protected.
results.remarks: PORTIDE RBAC prevents role-drift: operational roles cannot be altered via user contact editing.

results.objective: Verify Port Administrator can delete an internal staff user account.
results.preconditions: Selenium-created staff user (selenium.ops.20261007153326@testportide.com) present in directory.
results.actions: 1. Click Delete button for selenium.ops.20261007153326@testportide.com. 2. Verify confirmation dialog. 3. Confirm deletion. 4. Verify toast and row removal.
results.expected_result: User is successfully deleted after confirmation and removed from the directory table.
results.actual_result: User deleted successfully in 8444 ms. Profile removed from directory list and database.
results.remarks: AdminUserDetailAPIView performed atomic deletion of User profile and Login record.

results.objective: Verify deleted staff user account can no longer authenticate.
results.actions: 1. Navigate to /login. 2. Attempt authentication with deleted credentials. 3. Verify access rejection.
results.expected_result: Authentication is rejected because the account no longer exists or is inactive.
results.actual_result: Deleted user authentication rejected in 3281 ms. Error feedback: 'Invalid email or password.'. Account cannot access platform.
results.remarks: Backend Login record successfully purged upon user deletion.

results.test_name: USER-017 – ADMIN USER MANAGEMENT ACCESS CONTROL
results.objective: Verify non-admin users cannot access Admin User Management.
results.preconditions: Logged in as Shipping Company user (selenium.ship.primary.20261007144406@testportide.com).
results.actions: 1. Authenticate as Shipping Company. 2. Attempt direct navigation to /admin/users. 3. Verify access denial and redirection.
results.expected_result: Unauthorized user is denied access and redirected to their authorized dashboard by ProtectedRoute.
results.actual_result: Access control enforced in 8925 ms. Direct navigation to /admin/users was blocked; redirected to http://localhost:3000/shipping/dashboard. Admin directory is inaccessible to non-admin roles.
results.remarks: ProtectedRoute.tsx and Django IsPortAdministrator permission classes enforce strict zero-trust RBAC.
